gameDescriptionHtml:
The Rewinder 2 is an action adventure game inspried by eastern methology. As the last known rewinder, you’ll wield the powers of Sizhi god to explore disrrupted villages, dungeons and save people from their dreams.

Game Features

  • Destroy Nightmares – Explore our unique memory levels and puzzles. As the last known rewinder, use your ability to explore others’ memory. Bring them out of nightmares.
  • Explore Dungeons – A unique set of dungeons are waiting for you to explore. Collect different charms to get various bonuses and special abilities.
  • Befriend Ghost and Monsters – Through out your journey, you will meet all sorts of monsters and ghosts, hear their stories and be friends with them.
